firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Click Open options on the overlay injected into the page
Tick the setting and watch the overlay move to the left edge
useCases: A Vue overlay injected into every page, isolated in a Shadow DOM
One setting shared between a Vue options page and a content script
Starting point for Vue extensions that need preferences

store.summary: Shows a small overlay UI on web pages, with an options page that moves it from right to left.

justifications.Content script match <all_urls>: The content script runs on the pages the user visits to render the extension's on-page interface. Narrow this to the specific sites your extension needs before submitting.
justifications.storage: keeps the one setting the options page writes so the overlay stays on the chosen edge after closing the page and restarting the browser. Nothing leaves the browser.

versionHistory: 1.0.0 (unreleased): initial version from the content-vue template. Not yet submitted to any store.
